title: Ukraine Aerial Crater Dataset: aerial and satellite images with YOLO annotations of explosion craters

creators.name: Zhukovskyy, Viktor
creators.affiliation: National University of Water and Environmental Engineering, Rivne, Ukraine

creators.name: Romasenko, Viktoriia
creators.affiliation: Dubrovytsia Lyceum; Rivne Junior Academy of Sciences, Ukraine

description:
Images taken from above (UAV, aerial and satellite) of areas in Ukraine damaged by shelling, with manually labelled explosion craters in YOLO format: 723 images, of which 711 are labelled; about 22,900 bounding boxes.

The dataset is intended for training and evaluating object detectors for automated assessment of war damage to land, in particular agricultural land.

Image sources and terms of use. Images were collected from open sources. Because of the war, systematic imaging of affected areas is difficult, so part of the images are fragments of Google Maps / Google Earth satellite imagery (marked "© Google"). Rights to these images belong to Google and its data providers; their use must follow the Google Maps / Google Earth terms of service. The dataset is provided for non-commercial academic use only. The annotations are licensed under CC BY-NC 4.0.
